content:
I am a builder who enjoys turning complex ideas into useful products. My approach is grounded in curiosity, careful iteration, and a preference for elegant systems over flashy solutions.
Over the years, I have worked across software engineering, research-oriented problem solving, and product development. The common thread in that work is a focus on making technology understandable, reliable, and genuinely helpful.
I am especially interested in the overlap between AI, design, and practical execution. I value thoughtful collaboration, clear communication, and products that feel effortless to use.
